candidate.professional_summary: Accomplished technology leader with extensive experience scaling enterprise platforms, directing cross-functional engineering teams, and modernizing digital infrastructure. Proven expertise in cloud architecture, technical roadmap execution, and operational governance that consistently accelerates product delivery and business growth.

experience.title: Director of Technology
bullets: Directed global technical roadmap and engineering operations across multi-disciplinary teams, scaling digital platform capacity by 150%.
Architected cloud infrastructure modernization and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, reducing release turnaround times by 40%.
Managed an annual technology budget and resource allocation, ensuring on-schedule delivery of all core platform initiatives.
Implemented comprehensive monitoring and site reliability standards, achieving 99.99% system uptime across high-volume services.

experience.title: Senior Technical Manager
bullets: Led engineering teams responsible for core enterprise web services and distributed data processing pipelines.
Partnered with product, security, and design stakeholders to execute high-impact software initiatives.
Mentored junior and senior engineers, establishing robust code review standards and engineering best practices.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
